A whole home, room by room

A whole home is captured one room at a time in one capture. It takes about 3 minutes a room.

  1. Create a new listing. Give it a name you will recognise, not the full address, and choose the whole home.
  2. Start in the first room and capture it as usual: see walk a room.
  3. At each doorway, tap Next room and name the room: Living, Kitchen, Bedroom, Bathroom, Hall, or Other for any name up to 32 characters.
  4. Carry on room by room, crossing each doorway slowly.
  5. After the last room, tap Finish & save. The phone check looks at every room.

If it doesn’t work

A capture holds up to 300 views. If it reaches the limit or its room limit, finish it and capture the other rooms as a new capture.

If a home is too big for one walkthrough, it may come back as too large for a phone. Split it into two captures.

If a room comes back as Needs recapture after rendering, tap Recapture and the room’s name. The capture starts in that room.

Still stuck? Email Veylet support

Write to yoda@yodalai.xyz and a person replies. Say which step you were on, your iPhone or iPad model, and the app version from Account, then About. Never send passwords or sign-in links.
